evidence.notes: Verifier takes a base64 warrant chain and a PoP signature only; trusted roots come from PAYMENT_TRUSTED_ISSUERS or constructor injection. PaymentClient.transfer now requires a VerifiedTransfer matching the requested recipient/amount, and tests attempt both original bypass shapes (direct client call, old two-argument execute_transfer). Wider child delegation is proven at grant time via the SDK's MonotonicityError rather than by presenting a forged wider chain to the verifier. Report separates the in-process guardrail from a service boundary and disclaims replay, revocation, exactly-once, and intent.
